messages:
Sophie: Quick heads up — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/11023 is blocked on arch signoff. RFC linked below. Can someone from arch take a look? :pray:

Tanay: Looping in @Maria and @Erin. Which parts specifically need architecture review? :eyes:

Sophie: The smart routing + fallback scoring and how we pick model variants when capacity is tight. RFC: https://rfc.internal/redwood/2026-03-smart-routing (see sect 4.2 and 5.1)

Maria: I can take a pass today. Will comment in the RFC; ETA ~ 2pm PT. Please add any targeted questions here so I don't miss them.

Jake: Heads up this PR also touches autoscaler hints for dedicated pools — I'll do a perf sanity check after arch signoff. cc @Tanay

Tanay: Do we want to gate merging on an explicit RFC approval label? If so we should add a bot label to prevent accidental merges.

Sophie: Yes — gating required. Merge criteria: 1) RFC receives arch + infra ack, 2) PR gets 1 infra + 1 perf approval, 3) e2e test added for fallback ordering. Branch: `feat/smart-routing-11023`

ArchReviewBot: RFC 2026-03-smart-routing assigned to Maria, Erin — review requested. Deadline: 2026-06-03. Label added: `rfc-review-pending`.

Maria: Left inline comments on RFC section 4.2 about the fallback scoring weights. Main question: how should we break ties between equal score variants? Suggested tie-breaker: prefer lower observed p95 latency, then lower cost.

Sophie: Good point — I added a note in the PR and a TODO in RFC to codify tie-breaker. Will push a small change now and add an e2e test that simulates identical scores to assert ordering.

Erin: I'll review the PR tomorrow morning and check the fallback test. If the tie-breaker is explicit and tests pass, arch should be able to +1.

Jake: After tests are in I'll run a quick perf diff on staging. ETA ~24h from when Sophie pushes the test.

Sophie: Thanks all. I've labeled the PR `rfc-pending` and locked merge until RFC has `arch-ack`. Re-ping here once the RFC comments are addressed so we can remove the block. :thumbsup:

Tanay: Nice — thanks for coordinating. If anyone needs a quick sync, we can do a 15m standup this afternoon.

Sophie: I'll keep it async unless we get stuck. Posting changes in the PR now.
